art_direction: 低弧长眼配不齐短下线，黑瞳向左，局部笔压较重，无嘴。
composition: centered hand-drawn eye pair; auxiliary marks only when specified; large blank paper margins

color_randomization.method: golden-angle hue spacing with seeded single-hue saturation and lightness variation

color_treatment: one opaque flat color beside each pupil; no gradient or shaded rendering
creative_direction: Make two low, long upper arcs with a heavier pen touch near the outer thirds. The bottom marks are shorter and sit at slightly different distances below the lids. Keep both eyes open, with large pupils shifted left and narrow paper openings cut through the dark. The left outer end rises a little; the right ends bluntly. Add only two short brows, one nearly flat. No mouth. Avoid filling every gap or correcting the small asymmetry.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
